mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mp.member_perfume_id) FROM member_perfume mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_delete = FALSE AND p.is_delete = FALSE

SELECT a.accord_name AS accordName, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.perfume_id) AS count, 0.0 AS ratio FROM member_perfume mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND p.is_delete = FALSE JOIN perfume_accord pa ON p.perfume_id = pa.perfume_id AND pa.is_delete = FALSE JOIN accord a ON pa.accord_id = a.accord_id AND a.is_delete = FALSE WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_delete = FALSE GROUP BY a.accord_id, a.accord_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT n.note_name AS noteName, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.perfume_id) AS count, 0.0 AS ratio FROM member_perfume mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND p.is_delete = FALSE JOIN perfume_note pn ON p.perfume_id = pn.perfume_id AND pn.is_delete = FALSE JOIN note n ON pn.note_id = n.note_id AND n.is_delete = FALSE WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_delete = FALSE GROUP BY n.note_id, n.note_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT n.note_name AS noteName, COUNT(DISTINCT mp.perfume_id) AS count, 0.0 AS ratio FROM member_perfume mp JOIN perfume p ON mp.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND p.is_delete = FALSE JOIN perfume_note pn ON p.perfume_id = pn.perfume_id AND pn.is_delete = FALSE JOIN note n ON pn.note_id = n.note_id AND n.is_delete = FALSE WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_delete = FALSE AND pn.note_level = #{noteLevel}::note_level_enum GROUP BY n.note_id, n.note_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.perfume_id AS perfumeId, p.perfume_name AS perfumeName, p.image_route AS imageRoute, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(a2.accord_name, ',' ORDER BY pa2.perfume_accord_id) FROM perfume_accord pa2 JOIN accord a2 ON pa2.accord_id = a2.accord_id AND a2.is_delete = FALSE WHERE pa2.perfume_id = p.perfume_id AND pa2.is_delete = FALSE ) AS accordNames FROM perfume p JOIN likes l ON p.perfume_id = l.perfume_id AND l.is_delete = FALSE WHERE p.is_delete = FALSE GROUP BY p.perfume_id, p.perfume_name, p.image_route ORDER BY COUNT(l.likes_id) DESC LIMIT 5
